title: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms: card flavor text

entities.name: Selûne
entities.description: A goddess who guides her devotees, including moon-blessed clerics, with wisdom and grace.

entities.name: Moradin
entities.description: A god to whom a dwarven paladin swore an oath.

entities.name: Bartleby
entities.description: A gnome wizard who uses teleportation circles.

entities.name: Elemental Evil
entities.description: A force that distorts the natural elements, limiting them to aspects of destruction.

entities.name: Deck of Many Things
entities.description: A magical deck whose lucky draws can have strange effects.

entities.name: Voltusk
entities.description: One who drew from the Deck of Many Things and gained a flash of understanding he spent his life trying to repeat.

entities.name: Lady Luck
entities.description: A figure of fortune invoked by tricksters.

entities.name: Myrkul
entities.description: A god of the dead served by death-priests who raise the dead.

entities.name: The Abyss
entities.description: A bottomless realm into which Demogorgon drags the corrupted.

entities.name: Nihiloor
entities.description: The spymaster of the Xanathar Guild, a devourer of others' knowledge.

entities.name: Xanathar Guild
entities.description: A criminal guild led by Xanathar.

entities.name: Xanathar
entities.description: The leader of the Xanathar Guild, who jokes about the zombified ogre Throg.

entities.name: Throg
entities.description: An ogre turned into a zombie who no longer thinks he's clever.

entities.name: Lolth
entities.description: The drow goddess whose image driders embody; driders are drow who failed her.

entities.name: Nestus Wrasse
entities.description: A necromancer who raises the dead as dungeon crawlers.

entities.name: Aramil
entities.description: An adventurer who issued a heroic challenge to a lich and was slain by a single word.

entities.name: Erigan
entities.description: An adventurer struck by a ray of enfeeblement.

entities.name: Waterdeep
entities.description: A city with a harbor, where a hoard robber once picked pockets.

entities.name: Jym
entities.description: A barbarian of Baldur's Gate who prefers kicking in doors.

entities.name: Baldur's Gate
entities.description: A city with sewers, home of the barbarian Jym.

entities.name: Imvaernarhro
entities.description: An ancient dragon who has earned a fiery nickname.

entities.name: Jarro
entities.description: A battle master wary of rust monsters.

entities.name: Ellywick Tumblestrum
entities.description: A singer of songs who urges Varis along in choosing weapons.

entities.name: Elemental Plane of Earth
entities.description: The native plane of xorns, where gems and rare stones are plentiful.

entities.name: Nadaar
entities.description: An adventurer who calmly takes charge at a gnoll camp.

entities.name: Varis
entities.description: A Silverymoon ranger, an archer.

entities.name: Silverymoon
entities.description: A city; a vanished caravan was bound for it.

entities.name: Zalto
entities.description: A fire giant duke, one of the greatest warmongers of his age.

entities.name: Circle of Dreams
entities.description: A druid circle protecting gleaming, fruitful realms where dream and reality blur.

entities.name: Circle of the Moon
entities.description: A druid circle of fierce guardians of nature in the deepest wilderness.

entities.name: Fall of Elturel
entities.description: The fall of the city of Elturel, after which its rangers walked the Sword Coast.

entities.name: Elturel
entities.description: A city that fell.

entities.name: Sword Coast
entities.description: A region stretching from Tethyr to Icewind Dale.

entities.name: Tethyr
entities.description: A land at one end of the Sword Coast.

entities.name: Icewind Dale
entities.description: A cold land at one end of the Sword Coast.

entities.name: Claugiyliamatar
entities.description: An ancient green dragon often seen with a mangled corpse dangling from her mouth.

entities.name: Feywild
entities.description: A realm where some insist owlbears have always dwelled.

entities.name: The Tarrasque
entities.description: A monster whose rising makes nations fall.

entities.name: Larissa Kyriln
entities.description: A learned warlock who identifies a basilisk's handiwork.

entities.name: Eilistraee
entities.description: A goddess who teaches that one is not bound by the circumstances of birth.

entities.name: Trelasarra
entities.description: A follower of Eilistraee.

entities.name: Tiamat
entities.description: A dragon goddess who declares her children will rule over all.

entities.name: Faerûn
entities.description: A land parts of which still churn with the magic of long-dead Netherese archmages.

entities.name: Netherese
entities.description: Arrogant archmages, long dead, whose magic lingers in Faerûn.

entities.name: Ten-Towns
entities.description: Settlements troubled by tensions over dwindling reindeer.

entities.name: Maelstrom
entities.description: The seat of a storm giant king.

entities.name: Underdark
entities.description: The underground world beneath the surface, source of monsters and fungi.

entities.name: Mere of Dead Men
entities.description: A swamp where a search for a stolen artifact leads.

entities.name: Hundelstone
entities.description: A mining settlement where miners tell of whispers in the dark below.

entities.name: Spine of the World
entities.description: A mountain range where every cave hides new danger.

entities.name: Neverwinter Wood
entities.description: A forest whose inhabitants may not welcome visitors.

entities.name: Skullport
entities.description: A place with gruff merchants.

events.summary: Voltusk draws from the Deck of Many Things and gains a flash of understanding he spends his life trying to repeat.
events.quote: A lucky draw from the Deck of Many Things gave Voltusk an inexplicable flash of understanding that he spent the rest of his life trying to repeat.

events.summary: Aramil challenges a lich and is killed with a single word.
events.quote: Aramil issued a long, heroic challenge, then the lich felled him with a single word.

events.summary: Erigan is struck by a hideous weakness.
events.quote: Erigan cried out in pain as a hideous weakness settled into his bones.

events.summary: After the fall of Elturel, its rangers walk the Sword Coast hunting prey.
events.quote: Since the fall of Elturel, they've walked the Sword Coast from Tethyr to Icewind Dale, eyes always on their prey.

events.summary: The storm giant king of the Maelstrom calls his kin to council after alarming news.
events.quote: Alarmed by the news you brought, the storm giant king of the Maelstrom has called his kin to council.

relations.quote: "Move it, Varis, or I'll pick one for you!"
"On the plus side, Throg no longer thinks he's clever."
"Eilistraee teaches us that we are not bound by the circumstances of our birth.
